name: China Graphite Group Limited
summary: China Graphite Group Limited, established in 2006 and based in Hegang, produces and sells flake graphite concentrate and spherical graphite in China, and is a subsidiary of Sandy Mining Limited. It mines graphite ore at its Beishan Mine in Heilongjiang Province and also buys graphite from outside suppliers, and sells unrefined marble. Customers are mainly industrial manufacturers and retailers needing heat-resistant materials.
